summary: Validated the SpendGuard landing page at the public frontend URL on desktop and mobile. Hero, narrative sections, CTAs, anchor navigation, reduced-motion loading, test IDs, and mobile overflow all passed; no rendered errors or browser console failures were observed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Desktop and mobile landing-page smoke/e2e coverage completed. Navigation assertions require waiting for smooth-scroll settlement.
rca of the issue: The initial automated assertion checked the destination too early while smooth scrolling was still in progress; rerunning with a settled-scroll wait passed all destinations. This was a test timing issue, not an application defect.
